title: 义务教育教科书·英语（译林）四年级下册

sentences.cn: 森林里有一头狮子，那儿有很多树。
sentences.en: There is a lion in the forest, and there are many trees there.

sentences.cn: 狮子很强壮，可老鼠却又弱又瘦。
sentences.en: The lion is strong, but the mouse is weak and thin.

sentences.cn: 有一天，他们成了好朋友。
sentences.en: One day they become good friends.

sentences.cn: 他用网把他们罩住了。
sentences.en: He catches them in a net.

sentences.cn: 求求你救救我！走开，坏猫！
sentences.en: Please help me! Go away, bad cat!

sentences.cn: 我怎么才能从这个洞里出去？
sentences.en: How can I get out of this hole?

sentences.cn: 狮子又生气又难过。
sentences.en: The lion is angry and sad.

sentences.cn: 我的背很疼。
sentences.en: My back hurts.

sentences.cn: 他对我很友好，我们的友谊很深。
sentences.en: He is kind to me, and we have a good friendship.

sentences.cn: 我们开个聚会吧，我喜欢你的主意。
sentences.en: Let’s have a party, and I like your idea.

sentences.cn: 这只老鼠来自森林。
sentences.en: The mouse comes from the forest.

sentences.cn: 我带你参观一下我们的学校。
sentences.en: Let me show you around our school.

sentences.cn: 这是我们的操场，那是秋千。
sentences.en: This is our playground, and that is the swing.

sentences.cn: 我的教室在一楼。
sentences.en: My classroom is on the first floor.

sentences.cn: 电脑教室在二楼。
sentences.en: The computer room is on the second floor.

sentences.cn: 钢琴在三楼的音乐教室里。
sentences.en: The piano is in the music room on the third floor.

sentences.cn: 去看看另一个房间吧。
sentences.en: Have a look at the other room.

sentences.cn: 小心点，我在这儿感觉很开心。
sentences.en: Be careful, and I feel happy here.

sentences.cn: 请带上你的包，我们待会儿就走。
sentences.en: Please take your bag, and we will go later.

sentences.cn: 你有什么问题吗？
sentences.en: Do you have any questions?

sentences.cn: 我们必须学习道路安全知识。
sentences.en: We must learn about road safety.

sentences.cn: 坐公共汽车，在下一站下车。
sentences.en: Take the bus and get off at the next stop.

sentences.cn: 等红绿灯，安全的时候再过马路。
sentences.en: Wait for the traffic light, and cross the road when it is safe.

sentences.cn: 路上人来车往，所以跟紧我。
sentences.en: The road is busy, so stay close to me.

sentences.cn: 过马路前看看左边和右边。
sentences.en: Look left and right before you cross.

sentences.cn: 怎么了？你看起来很累。
sentences.en: What’s the matter? You look tired.

sentences.cn: 我又饿又渴，想喝点水。
sentences.en: I am hungry and thirsty, and I want some water.

sentences.cn: 他生病了，所以回家了。
sentences.en: He is ill, so he goes home.

sentences.cn: 亲爱的，休息一下吧。天很闷热。
sentences.en: Have a rest, dear. It is hot.

sentences.cn: 摆好餐具，把面包放上去。
sentences.en: Set the table, and put the bread on it.

sentences.cn: 我的包很重，你很关心我。
sentences.en: My bag is heavy, and you care about me.

sentences.cn: 我们今天出去吃饭吧。
sentences.en: Let’s eat out today.

sentences.cn: 你想要什么？这是菜单。
sentences.en: What would you like? Here is the menu.

sentences.cn: 我要炒饭、一份春卷和一碗面条。
sentences.en: I would like fried rice, a spring roll and a bowl of noodles.

sentences.cn: 请来一杯茶和一杯果汁。
sentences.en: A cup of tea and a glass of juice, please.

sentences.cn: 炸鱼薯条和三明治是我最喜欢的食物。
sentences.en: Fish and chips and a sandwich are my favourite food.

sentences.cn: 热狗很好吃。还要别的吗？
sentences.en: The hot dog is delicious. Anything else?

sentences.cn: 下次我们吃火锅吧。
sentences.en: Next time let’s have hot pot.

sentences.cn: 把它装进打包盒里。
sentences.en: Put it in a takeaway box.

sentences.cn: 我父母都有好工作。
sentences.en: My parents have good jobs.

sentences.cn: 我爸爸是司机，我妈妈是护士。
sentences.en: My father is a driver, and my mother is a nurse.

sentences.cn: 医生和护士在医院工作。
sentences.en: The doctor and the nurse work in a hospital.

sentences.cn: 教师、工人和农民都是忙碌的人。
sentences.en: A teacher, a worker and a farmer are all busy people.

sentences.cn: 厨师在饭馆工作。
sentences.en: A cook works in a restaurant.

sentences.cn: 警察帮助生病的人。
sentences.en: A police officer helps sick people.

sentences.cn: 我坐出租车或火车去上班。
sentences.en: I go to work by taxi or by train.

sentences.cn: 这是个好地方，我认得路。
sentences.en: This is a good place, and I know the way.

sentences.cn: 多大的一所房子啊！
sentences.en: What a big house!

sentences.cn: 周末我在家做家务。
sentences.en: On the weekend I do chores at home.

sentences.cn: 我洗碗，还浇花。
sentences.en: I wash the dishes and water the flowers.

sentences.cn: 我铺床，这是我分内的事。
sentences.en: I make the bed, and that is part of my work.

sentences.cn: 干得漂亮！你做完一半了。
sentences.en: Good job! You finished half of it.

sentences.cn: 七点半了，所以我们得走了。
sentences.en: It is half past seven, so we must go.

sentences.cn: 妈妈在厨房里。我等不及了！
sentences.en: Mum is in the kitchen. I can’t wait!

sentences.cn: 去拿些牛奶、一个西红柿和一个土豆。
sentences.en: Get some milk, a tomato and a potato.

sentences.cn: 把肉和鸡肉切开。
sentences.en: Cut the meat and the chicken.

sentences.cn: 往汤里打一个鸡蛋，然后端给他。
sentences.en: Put an egg in the soup, and give it to him.

sentences.cn: 今天是你的生日，蛋糕真的很好吃。
sentences.en: It is your birthday, and the cake is really good.
